incident_text: A house is on fire in our street. Flames are coming out of the roof and the front door.

result.scene_summary: A house is engulfed in flames, with fire visibly spreading across the roof and through the front door and porch area.

observations.description: Large flames are visible through the front door and roof, with fire consuming the roof and interior structure.
The roof is partially collapsed or buckling under fire, and the front door is open and burning.
The house has a porch and siding, with an adjacent structure or extension visible to the right.
No vehicles are visible in the image.
No people are visible in the image.
Trees are visible in the background, and some grass is visible in the foreground.
A chimney is visible on the roofline, and some debris is on the ground around the house.
